description: This file is a shell script containing functions and variables for pretty-printing test script output in GitHub workflows. It includes functions to start and finalize test output, and manages output formatting with GitHub-specific markup commands.

methods.name: start_test_output
methods.description: Initializes output markup, checks for verbose log, and resets output file.

methods.name: finalize_test_case_output
methods.description: Processes test case result and outputs corresponding GitHub markup, handles different test outcomes.
